reviews.text: I received this referral, from my neighbor who has replaced his house's roof over the years, two times with Garland. My new insurance company canceled my policy due to suspected roof damage. After three roofers gave me a bid to ONLY replace the roof, not repair; Garland was happy to repair my 8 year old roof, and I now HAVE insurance. Thank you Garland Roofing! Thank you Sam and Todd!

Garland Roofing Co, family owned business, is great to work with for roofing and fencing. My roof installation was done in 2014, and they did a great job! Most recently, April 2021, I worked with them for a new 8 foot, board-on-board fence. Again, they did a great job! Love my roof, love my fence. If you need roofing or fence work, please contact them. You will be glad you did.

Todd made it a very smooth process for a new and quality roof.  He was very attentive and always available for questions. Pedro was wonderful along with all the crew that put on my new roof. Clean up was impeccable and I highly recommend Garland Roofing for a stellar roofing job and/or experience!

Terrific experience with Garland Roofing Co. Prompt, competitive estimate delivered electronically. One of the best work crews we've ever had work on our almost 100 year old house, so we know pros and efficient work when it's performed. They were also one of the cleanest groups ever working on this old house. Big selection of roofing products and styles to choose from. Couldn't be more pleased!

Highly recommend Garland Roofing! They are a trustworthy family business. Excellent job on my new roof in Frisco. The job was completed quickly and  they did a great job cleaning up each day. These guys are the best around!

I just used Garland roofing for my second roof.  They did my roof at my last house and I was so impressed that I used them again.  Their price is competitive and I found their work to be once again superb.  Todd was easy to work with and everything was done on time and as expected.

This roofing installation firm performed exceptionally well. The finished product is of superior quality, and the attic ventilation was executed flawlessly. I would recommend them to anyone considering home improvement.

Love my new roof! Quality work! Went above and beyond to make sure I got the roof I wanted. Family owned business and they treat their customers like family!
Definitely recommend!

The repair they made failed to fix the roof leak and when I called them to come back out, they never got back to me.  A couple weeks went by and I attempted to contact them again, but no reply. Secretary did initially tell me that there was basically no guarantee on the work they performed and t
I should prepare to pay again. No, thanks.
Just had a new roof put on and am very happy with the work and communication along the way as I made several changes from the initial contract. Good price and the roof was on in one day.

Got to love people that do not honor the Do not call list.  Having a high pressure call to farm leads is a great way to demonstrate that you are an awful company.  Well someone is calling stating they are from your company.  called at 10:50 am from a 469 number ending in 7847

Great manager, awesome pricing and did a great roof replacement for our Wylie home.
I highly recommend them.
These guys did a great job on my North Dallas roof.  Finished the job quickly, no nails in the pool/yard.  VERY responsive.
I've been a contractor since mid 70s this is the best roofer that I have used
What a great roofing company!! A great experience from start to finish. Very impressed with clean-up.
Customer service, communication, and expertise were top notch (A1). They delivered as promised.
Great experience all around. Communication, price, quality of work, follow-up, costumer service, etc. Good family company and great people!
Great service finding and repairing a leak we had at a very reasonable price.
Did a great job on both my home and my parents home!
Great work, quick, clean, friendly!
